meshopt without quantization (lossless), from Blender's export

links.label: CC0, made for the Blender 4.0 release notes and manual (devtalk)

assets.changes: GLB exported by Blender (Khronos glTF Blender I/O v5.1.18); the Draco version exported by Blender too; the meshopt version is that GLB with EXT_meshopt_compression and no quantization (every vertex identical, triangles the same, 6.4 to 4.1 MB). The .blend compressed with zstd (lossless, 41.0 to 27.1 MB). Not in the GLBs: the area lights (glTF has no area lights). blender/shaderball-jesus-sandoval.glb in the bucket is an earlier conversion with threepipe's blend importer, not listed (see issues/open/blend-importer-camera-shift-area-lights.md)
